records: The JPYSC October 30 outstanding amount of approximately JPY20.8B is secondary reporting, not an issuer-confirmed reserve disclosure. The official SBI October 30 release confirms an agreed 5% SMBC capital participation, but completion/closing was not independently verified. Open Standard/JYPSC/OUSD interoperability is exploratory; no live transfer or direct Coinbase-JPYSC commercial contract is established.
